title: Rajasthan Royals Tactical Compatibility & Partnership Engine
methodologyNote: Combines empirical partnership telemetry from 4,423 match partnerships with tactical complementary projections where pair has not shared the crease.

battingTandems.name: Yashasvi Jaiswal & Sanju Samson
battingTandems.tacticalMechanism: Jaiswal attacks aggressively in Powerplay (160+ SR vs Pace), allowing Samson to anchor and target middle-overs spin with clean slog-sweeps.
battingTandems.jaipurAdvantage: Exploits asymmetric SMS Jaipur boundary dimensions by rotating strike to target shorter square boundary.

battingTandems.name: Sanju Samson & Naman Dhir
battingTandems.tacticalMechanism: Samson controls overs 11-16 manipulating fielders into the ring, removing run-rate pressure from Dhir who enters at #7 with mandate to detonate from ball 1.
battingTandems.jaipurAdvantage: Dhir straight power striking clears longest boundaries, neutralizing opposition boundary sweepers.

battingTandems.name: Rishabh Pant & Shashank Singh
battingTandems.tacticalMechanism: Forces captains out of pre-programmed bowler match-ups. Continuous strike rotation induces fielding misalignments and boundary leaks.
battingTandems.jaipurAdvantage: Eliminates one-sided field sets at Sawai Mansingh Stadium.

battingTandems.name: Riyan Parag & Shimron Hetmyer
battingTandems.tacticalMechanism: Parag neutralizes finger spin in overs 9–14, creating launchpad for Hetmyer to harvest pacers in overs 16–20 at 190+ SR.
battingTandems.jaipurAdvantage: Punishes back-of-length deliveries against SMS Jaipur subcontinental bounce.

bowlingTandems.name: Sandeep Sharma & Hasan Mahmud
bowlingTandems.archetype: Swing Craft & 140k Searing Yorker Death Vice
bowlingTandems.tacticalMechanism: Sandeep utilizes wide knuckleballs and slower bouncers; Mahmud attacks the base of off-stump at 140 km/h. Opposition batters face extreme velocity and trajectory variance.
bowlingTandems.jaipurAdvantage: Defends sub-175 totals when night dew slows down the pitch.

bowlingTandems.name: Sunil Narine & Umran Malik
bowlingTandems.archetype: Mystery Spin Chokehold + 150+ km/h Raw Hostility
bowlingTandems.tacticalMechanism: Narine restricts scoring to sub-6.5 RPO in overs 7-13. Panicked batters enter middle overs facing required rates above 11.0 and are forced to attack Umran Malik hostile pace.
bowlingTandems.jaipurAdvantage: SMS Jaipur 70m+ outfield converts mistimed pulls into simple boundary catches.

bowlingTandems.name: Mitchell Santner & Sandeep Sharma
bowlingTandems.tacticalMechanism: Both bowlers execute with near-zero error margins (<0.90 boundaries per over conceded). Stifles momentum in high-pressure chases.
bowlingTandems.jaipurAdvantage: Stump-to-stump accuracy punishes visiting teams unfamiliar with Jaipur bounce.
